floor_holding.note: Floor-holding intervals and internal gaps are retained from turn_gap_analysis; values are not re-derived without its exact schema.

speaker_transitions.note: These are structural speaker changes, not automatically interruptions.

floor_transition_classification.description: Configured post-overlap floor-transition classifications; separate from structural changes.

summary.note: Duration bins are descriptive. B/C require conversational-function evidence; short duration alone does not assign a semantic cluster.

followup_analysis.description: Post-overlap speech observations in the configured follow-up window.

language_scope.out_of_scope_policy: Flag non-English, mixed-language, or uncertain speech for review; do not silently classify it as English.

classification_taxonomy.target_speaker_policy: Use a speaker label only when the target is supported by transcript/context; otherwise null.
classification_taxonomy.inference_policy: Observable timing/order is not by itself proof of conversational intent. Use transcript evidence and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: Dr. Zafar Islam, Rahul Gandhi has now shifted the blame to the BJP itself.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: He's claiming that how the party workers, the protesters who had come to the national capital, they were ready to shop in Delhi, but the shops in Karnat place were in fact shut and he's blaming the BJP for this.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Rally, which is which has no agenda.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_00
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: Rally, which is which has no agenda.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: Nigat wants to make a point on that.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Had there been super success of this Maharali, where 10 lakh people would have turned, on Delhi state, you would not have been able to drive a car or that whole Delhi would have experienced the chakka jaan.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_00
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: Despite all the allegations they are making, at the end, they are getting exposed.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: All right, Nigat, we'll also come to the charges, the allegations that were made by the India bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi also.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_03
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Zafar Bhai you are more than that.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_04
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: All right, Nigat, we'll also come to the charges, the allegations that were made by the India bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi also.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_00
speech_events.text: If somebody is making allegation, they should make, they should,

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: Show the Honorable Court that these are the evidence which I want to put in front of you, that they, instead of making this kind of allegation, but they can only make allegation because they know that everything was done with the right spirit.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_00
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: instead of making allegation, if they can substantiate, then they must approach the Honorable Court.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: Alright, so Dr. Zafar Islam is essentially questioning the support of the people that the Congress party... They don't have any positive agenda.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_00
speech_events.text: all right they don't have any positive agenda they have they have no alternative plan they have that there's nothing they can project to the people common man right obviously for common man would like to say if what is the alternative you have all right because

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: People have categorically rejected, very clearly rejected the opposition parties and they will continue to reject.

immediately_preceding_speaker.speaker: SPEAKER_00
immediately_preceding_speaker.text: That only suggests that people's support, people's blessing is not with Congress party or for that matter with opposition parties.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: Thank you for joining us on the broadcast.

speech_events.speaker: SPEAKER_04
speech_events.text: Nikit Kaushik, thank you for joining us on India Today.

pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
pre_overlap_speaker_sequence.text: But you have absolutely no proof.

notes: This artifact is a separate analysis output; it does not modify final.json or any existing pipeline stage.
Transcript text and source segment timestamps are preserved exactly; events may extend beyond the 3-second window and are flagged.
All classification and host-behavior fields are intentionally unclassified pending manual verification and later LLM analysis.
first_speaker_in_window accounts for speech already active at the window boundary; first_new_speaker_after_overlap separately records a segment beginning after the overlap.
Tied or ambiguous speaker starts are represented as null rather than forcing a conclusion.
Speaker labels are diarization labels, not verified real-world identities.

interaction_clusters.description: Cluster A structural transition candidates; clusters B-G overlap interaction classifications.

topic_modeling.description: Topics, subtopics, assignments, distribution, timeline, and drift from topic-modeling artifact.

topic_interaction_analysis.note: Requires topic-segment timestamps aligned to overlap/interruption events. No causal claim is made by this script.

host_identification.description: Host identity, top candidates, and evidence.

host_actions.description: Host action classification; inspect completion/failure and label distributions before interpreting.

host_participation.note: Host participation can be computed once the host identity is verified against speaker IDs.

interruption_management.description: Host handling of interruptions, if produced.

speaker_interaction_analysis.note: Requires validated event-level speaker roles; transition counts alone do not establish interaction function.

validation_and_data_quality.warning: A source file being present does not imply its classification completed successfully; inspect its own status fields.

methodology_and_configuration.transition_definition: Adjacent turns from different speakers in chronological order.
methodology_and_configuration.principle: Computed values are distinguished from unavailable, pending, or source-preserved analyses. No causal interpretation is inferred.
